page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1865.39 and a multi-core score of 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1689.81 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 141.73 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the server processes Redis SET operations at 30.13 million operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 28.84 GB/sec.

The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage for data-intensive operations. However, the high memory density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for memory-bound workloads that do not require local disk performance. The instance is well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference, where its 256 GB RAM capacity prevents out-of-memory bottlenecks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server provides 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per core memory allocation. It lacks local storage and GPUs, relying on a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks place the instance in the average tier, with a passmark CPU score of 35326.14 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 13384.0. It demonstrates strong capabilities in memory-bound tasks, processing 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second and achieving 282.15 tokens per second in text generation with a small 135M LLM. This hardware profile is highly suitable for in-memory databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity without the need for local NVMe storage.
